scope: Complete surviving Ahlden House/Schloss Ahlden main U-shaped building: original named native footprint, three joined steep red-tile roof ranges with timbered gable ends/dormers/chimneys, brick ground floor and dark oak half-timber frame/red brick infill/white casements, true arched vehicle gateway and smaller pedestrian passage through the western main wing, attached sandstone heraldic portal relief. Preserve the east-open courtyard as unbuilt space. Exclude park/trees/river/moat/approach bridge/fences/freestanding garden monuments, interiors/auction exhibits/people and copied lettering. Roof sections/bay census/concealed timber joints and precise grade are architectural estimates.

quallaSearch.notes: Qualla-first: four native creator Axel Hindemith/AxelHH2008photographs actually inspected, all SHA1matched to pinned original Commons records. Explicit photograph-by-AxelHH source and own PD-self release, with original German upload attribution/Bild-frei logs, not a bare author assumption. Front controls brick-base/upper oak frame/casements/twin arched passages and roof; rear/river-side controls full timbered gables and joined wings; crest detail controls intrinsic sandstone frame/robed heraldic figures/shield only. Trees obscure some bays; their census and hidden roof joints remain estimates. Uncertain1747plan/other views/artifacts/attribution photos not used. No outside image, generated bitmap or copied photographic texture.
